variants.label: Approved research-plan proposal
variants.objective: Recover a physically reachable goal after a reversible disturbance.
variants.success_criteria: Compare matched disturbed states with and without usable feedback, retaining an independently verified reachable parent task.
constraints: The disturbance must be reversible and independently measured.
Do not infer recovery ability from an unchanged repeat.
variants.evidence_summary: Design feedback only. No authored scene, native execution or model evaluation yet.
